{{Short description|British statistician}}
{{Use dmy dates|cs1-dates=ly|date=November 2022}}
{{Use list-defined references|date=November 2022}}
'''Veronica Elizabeth''' ('''Ronni''') '''Bowman''' {{post-nominals|country=GBR|OBE|FIMA|FRSS}} is a British military statistician specialising in [[Bayesian inference]] and [[uncertainty]], and their applications in [[knowledge management]] for chemical, biological and radiological threats.{{r|notwrong}} She is a professor and data science fellow at the [[Defence Science and Technology Laboratory]],{{r|frss|newyear}} and an associate member of the Southampton Statistical Sciences Research Institute at the [[University of Southampton]].{{r|soton}}

==Education==
Bowman was a mathematics student at the University of Southampton, where she earned a BSc with first class honours before completing a doctorate in statistical modelling.{{r|liverpool}}

==Recognition==
Bowman is a [[Fellow of the Royal Statistical Society]]{{r|frss}} and of the [[Institute of Mathematics and its Applications]].{{r|liverpool}}

Bowman was the 2021 winner of the Innovation and Creativity Award at the Women in Defence UK Awards.{{r|wid|nica}} In the [[2022 New Year Honours]], Bowman was named as an Officer of the [[Order of the British Empire]], for her work developing CrystalCast, a system for 
uncertainty analysis and Bayesian model combination that was applied to combine academic and government [[epidemiology|epidemiological]] predictions in the [[COVID-19 pandemic]] in order to provide an estimate for the [[basic reproduction number]] of the disease.{{r|newyear|notwrong}}
